title: Concept: Fly Machines API endpoint with credentials
description: A Fly Machines API endpoint paired with an app token in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The Machines API can start, stop and replace the VM that serves the App, so a leaked token is remote control over the runtime even without repository access.
applicability: Deployments that render a Fly Machines API endpoint paired with an app token into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The Machines API can start, stop and replace the VM that serves the App, so a leaked token is remote control over the runtime even without repository access.
